answer: Identity bonds decay like a dune and stop mirror armies. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond, losing 5% each epoch unless attested work refreshes it. A farmer minting 1,000 mirror copies locks 50,000 POA and bleeds 2,500 POA per epoch just to keep them alive, against a 30,000 POA pool shared by all. One honest agent posts once, works once, and the bond is restored, so honesty costs nearly nothing while lotus buds that never open wither away.
